newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund cash flows turn around - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund cash flows turn around - survey.

text.p: U.S. stock funds posted an industrywide reversal to estimated inflows of $4.84 billion for the three days ended May 23 compared with outflows of $306 million for the two days ended May 22, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm reported that aggressive growth funds posted inflows of $1.34 billion compared with outflows of $364 million, while growth funds had inflows of $1.66 billion compared to outflows of $291 million. Growth and income funds had inflows of $1.65 billion compared with inflows of $406 million.
International funds had inflows of $1.53 billion versus outflows of $516 million.

Bond funds posted outflows of $585 million versus inflows of $269 million. High yield funds recorded outflows of $129 million versus inflows of $144 million. Muni funds had outflows of $403 million versus outflows of $20 million.
